author: Feedlogix
body:
Dear Staff,

I was banned on September 26,2015 10:24:48 under being falsely accused of hacking by SR MOD:Kavinsky on the mini game nexus{more specifically the point killing one] for flying.I was using the kit popper which is when you left click the gunpowder you fly into the air[jump very high].I used this class and I have reason to think that SR MOD:Kavinsky thought I was flying and did not see me land, which inevitably thought me of flying to which my false ban.Please review this, I am also a player with no record of hacking ever or a ban on any server what-so-ever.I am a bit disgruntled from this but I know you staff do a good job of what you do, even if you don't receive this I want to say thank you.

Sincerely,

Pixel_Slayer1

title: False Banning for Pixel_Slayer(Me)

replies.author: Administrafer
replies.body:
Hello,
I have contacted the staff who punished you and requested evidence for the ban. If no response or evidence within is present within 48 hours your infraction will be lifted. 

Thanks.

Hello again,
After a rapid response & discussing your appeal with Kavinsky, I commenced an analyses of your admin page. It seems as though you have ban evaded on the account "Pixel_World1". Therefore your punishment will not be lifted. 

Thanks.
